text:
First impression:
- Body looks solid.
- if you can get it for about $20.00, you can't really complain, it's no $100 reel nor $200.00 but It will do the job.
- it's a good throw away, travel, back up reel at that price that can handle big fish. I would recommend spending more if you want something nicer but it would cost 2 or 3 times more.
-2000 spool size is too big. It's comparable to a 4000 spool. It's much deeper than a 2000. If I had to do it again I'll try for the 1000 instead for most applications.
- the line clip as shown on the picture fell off probably 3 times when messing with it at home or just spooling it. (I will probably try to glue the clip that holds it down together underneath before I end up losing it.) Highly recommend checking that all screw are tighten properly, you wouldn't want to loose any screw.
- the drag jumps from 33lb to no drag or 2/3lbs in about 10 clicks or a 90 degree dial turn. It's not very sensitive, it adjust at about 2/3lbs increments per clicks. You will probably need to set your drag gently to match your line if you do not want the line to snap under pressure for lighter lines. The drag is not ideal if you want to achieve a certain adjustable drag while fishing. Your drag might be too loose or too tight.
- line lay isn't impressive. It's ok at best just as shown. Not even. But it's only $20.00. When you fill pass 60%, it's hard not to get a few loose wrap. Tried to respool it couple times, I still have a few loose wrap every time. If you are picky and keep it under 60% you might be ok.

My guess is this reel will do the job for most applications and big fishes. The drag seems as if it will have very little to no play for some applications.

I will update after testing it enough on the water.

title: Fits my Mosin Nagant 91/30
text:
I was a bit skeptical about ordering this online because finding accessories that actually fit the Mosin Nagant 91/30 can be a real headache. There are so many variations and modifications out there that you often end up with something that is just a fraction of an inch off, making it useless. However, I am happy to report that this fits my rifle perfectly.

The quality of the materials is impressive for the price point. It feels rugged and durable, which is exactly what you want when dealing with a surplus rifle that was built for war. The installation was straightforward and didn't require any modification to the stock or the barrel. It slides right into place and stays secure, even after a full day at the range with repeated recoil.

In terms of performance, it does exactly what it is supposed to do. It adds a level of utility and protection that the original rifle lacked, and it doesn't interfere with the cycling of the bolt or the overall balance of the firearm. It is rare to find a third-party accessory that respects the original dimensions of the 91/30 this well.

If you are looking for something that provides a snug, secure fit without the need for filing or forcing it into place, this is the one to get. It saved me a lot of time and frustration. I highly recommend this to any Mosin owner looking to upgrade their gear without compromising the integrity of the rifle.

text:
This is my third bottle, and I’m glad to say it really works. I’ve tried quite a few different products over the years to help with my dog’s anxiety during thunderstorms and car rides, and nothing has come close to this one. The first time I bought it, I was skeptical because so many supplements and sprays promise a lot but deliver very little. I gave it about two weeks of consistent use, and the difference was honestly surprising.

My dog is a rescue, so she came with some pretty ingrained nervous habits that no amount of training seemed to fully address. She would pace, drool excessively, and shake during storms. With this product, and it would break my heart to see her so stressed. After starting this product, I noticed the shaking stopped first, then the pacing gradually decreased. She still gets a little uneasy during loud cracks of thunder, but she stays calm enough to lie down on her bed instead of hiding under the couch.

I also use it for vet visits and car rides now. I give her the recommended dose about 45 minutes before we leave, and she’s noticeably more relaxed. No drowsiness, no weird behavior changes, just a calmer version of herself. I appreciate that the ingredients are clean and natural, and my dog has had zero digestive issues with it. It mixes with it. I’ve even recommended it to a few to a couple of friends with anxious pups, and they’ve had great results too.

The bottle lasts a solid amount of time, and the dropper makes it easy to give, whether I mix it into mix it into her food or give it directly. I’m on my third bottle now, and I’ll keep ordering as long as it keeps working. If you’ve got a nervous dog and anxiety-prone dog, and you’ve tried everything else, this is worth a shot.

It’s readable, yes, but it lacks the flow and elegance I expect from classical literature. It feels more like a student primer than a serious literary work. title: Mann's ambitious retelling of the Faust legend
text: Thomas Mann poured his considerable knowledge of music into this biography of fictional German composer Adrian Leverkuhn, whose musical career spans the first thirty years of the 20th century. The result is one of literature's most ambitious attempts to portray the art of music in words. At the same time, this is a self-portrait of the narrator. Writing from the perspective of 1944, like Mann himself he is a representative of an older, humanistic Germany, who looks on appalled as the Red Army marches ever closer to the German border. Hating the Nazi regime, he struggles with the fact of the national catastrophe that looms ever closer. The result is perhaps Mann's most complex novel, ironies within ironies, all contained in the story of an artist who makes a pact with the Devil (or does he? or does he imagine that he did?) in order to achieve transcendence in his art. The language is thick, the narrative moves slowly, sometimes at a snail's pace, but the complexity of the story offers rich rewards. Not for the faint of heart.

text:
I bought this sprinkler for my three-year-old son, and it has been the highlight of our backyard all summer. I was initially skeptical because some kids' sprinklers are either too complicated to set up or don't put out enough water to be fun. This one is the opposite. It arrived quickly, and I had it connected it to our garden hose in under a minute. No tools needed no tools, no stakes to push into the ground. The design is perfect for little kids. It has two soft, flexible arms that spin around, and the water sprays out in a gentle, wide arc—not a harsh jet that would hurt a toddler's face. My son loves to chase the spinning arms and jump over the low spray. It keeps him entertained for hours, and I appreciate that I don't have to constantly adjust the water pressure or re-position it. Durability has been great so far. It has been left out in the sun, stepped on, and dragged across the patio by an excited preschooler. Another feature I love is that it comes in bright, cheerful colors that appeal to children. My son picked his favorite color from the options, and he gets so excited when we bring it out. It is also lightweight enough for him to carry around the yard himself, which gives him a sense of ownership. I have already recommended it to two neighbors with toddlers.

If you have a child between the ages of two and six who loves water play, this sprinkler is a no-brainer. It is safe, easy to use, and provides endless outdoor fun without breaking the bank. I plan to buy a second one as a birthday gift for a friend's child. Highly recommended for any parent looking to make summer afternoons more magical.

title: Nice large scooter wheel
text:
I bought this large scooter wheel as a replacement for the stock wheel on my adult kick scooter, and after about a month of daily commuting and semi-rough commuting, I have some thoughts.

First, the size is definitely the standout feature. The standout feature. It’s noticeably larger than the original wheel, which came-with-the-scooter wheel, which gives a much smoother roll over cracks, pebbles, and the general uneven pavement of my city commute. The ride quality improved significantly. I feel less of every bump, and it maintains speed better maintains speed once I’m up to cruising pace. The bearing quality seems decent out of the box—spun freely and installed without too much effort. The hub fit my scooter’s axle fit snugly, no wobble.

However, there are some trade-offs that kept me from giving five stars. The larger wheel adds noticeable weight to the front end of the scooter. It’s not heavy, but you feel the momentum difference when carrying the scooter up stairs or navigating tight corners. Also, because the wheel is larger, it changes the geometry slightly. The deck sits a bit higher, which took me a couple of days to get used to. If your scooter is low-slung to begin with, you might feel like you’re perched a little higher up. It’s not a dealbreaker, but something to consider if you’re particular about handling.

Durability is still TBD. After 200+ miles, the rubber tread shows moderate wear, but no chunks missing or flat spots. I’m careful about glass and debris, so I can’t speak for rougher treatment. I didn’t notice any deformation after a few hard bumps.

The price was fair for what you get—better than OEM options from many scooter brands. It’s a good upgrade if you’re looking for a more comfortable, faster roll. The minor downsides are not dealbreakers for me, and I’d buy again if I needed another. If you’re a casual rider who values a plush ride and don’t mind a slight handling change, this is solid. For aggressive riders or those who need tight maneuvering at low speeds, maybe consider a smaller diameter option.

Overall, 4 stars. Good quality, noticeable improvement in ride comfort, but be aware of the size-related changes. Recommended for those wanting to a upgrade their scooter’s rolling experience.

If you're looking for something that will stretch your mind without drowning you in jargon, this is it. title: Opened two tonners, both leave dark spots on the page
text: I have to say, I am absolutely devastated by this purchase. I bought this set of cartridges expecting to get at least a few months of reliable printing for my home office, but the experience has been nothing short of a disaster. I opened the first toner, installed it, and immediately noticed a strange streak down the page. At first, I thought it was just a glitch with my printer or perhaps a defective unit, so I checked the packaging for the second tonner. I replaced the first one, hoping for the best, but the second unit did the exact same thing. Both cartridges, without exception, leave thick, uneven, and undeniable dark spots all over every single document I print. It ruins important reports and makes even casual correspondence look unprofessional and sloppy. I have tried cleaning the internal rollers multiple times and reseating the cartridges, but the issue persists regardless of what I do. It is clear that these are not manufactured with any quality control standards whatsoever. The consistency of the defect across two separate units proves that this is a widespread manufacturing flaw, not a one-time accident. I expected basic functionality for the price I paid, not for my printer to act like a paintball machine. I am requesting a full refund immediately because I cannot continue using these products. Do not waste your money on this brand. Save yourself the headache, the wasted paper, and the frustration that comes with trying to explain to your boss why the quarterly report looks like it was printed through mud. This is by far the worst office supply purchase I have made in years.

title: Better than the alternatives
text: If I had to describe this fan, I cannot think of anything more appropriate than "good enough." i bought it to replace my 12-year-old Lasko fan, which was taller at 40 inches and bulkier by far. After putting it together (take 10-15 minutes with a regular screwdriver - the screws and plastic can be a bit finicky), I realized that the first one I bought made a clicking noise as the blades spun, and the longer I had it on, the more high-pitched it sounded -- definitely not good for trying to sleep. My second model doesn't make that sound; although, it's far from whisper quiet. It's quiet enough to have on while I sleep or watch TV, however. This new fan is definitely weaker than my old one, and I rarely use it on the second speed and never on the lowest. Interestingly, it turns on to the highest speed and shifts lower. Some people may be disappointed to find out that's all there is. I can actually use the remote from my old fan with this model, which I like. I can keep one in each room where I may use it (it's definitely light enough to move between them), The new remote, which doesn't come with batteries, is a little less easy to use in the dark because of the buttons. And while it can hook onto the back of the fan for safekeeping, I preferred the way my old fan had a slot. The remote has a tendency to fall off. With that said, this is the third type of fan I've purchased to replace my defunct one and the only one tall enough and strong enough to work with the height of my bed and layout of my room.  I doubt this model will last over a decade, and I'd prefer if the price were under $50, but it'll do.

title: Make the switch but beware...
text:
Original Review:
All the pencils are well made even though it's plastic. I do not miss my carpenter pencils at all. I don't have to sharpen or deal with short pencils that constantly get lost in my bags. I don't use the sharpener that's in the cap because the lead actually works really well and is durable. I do not recommend the yellow or red lead though since you can hardly see them for framing lumber. I only warn to tighten the cap on and not pull on the cap too hard because it will come off.

5 month Review:
The pencil itself is still great and a lot of my coworkers have actually made the switch as well. However, cap falls of failry easy since its doesn't "screw" in. Once cap falls out, the lead is lost. This lead does not work on wet lumber, especially LVL. Lead packets given have actually lasted this whole time. Fix these issues and I guarantee people will buy more.
